title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Catalog usages and the unused scan stop contradicting each other
summary: Ctrl+click on an alias shows its usages, the unused dependency scan decides whether it has any. The two disagreed four ways out of five.

highlights.title: A commented out accessor is no longer a usage
highlights.description: An alias reported as dead would open onto a line someone had commented out, which is the very line the scan is meant to flag.

highlights.title: A lookup by name is one
highlights.description: An alias reached only through findLibrary or findPlugin said no definition found while the scan considered it alive.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Both features now share the same comment blanking and the same name matching, so they cannot drift apart again.
The blanking keeps every character offset: measured on 1295 usages of a real project, not one jump lands on the wrong spot.
